en.name: Canola oil
en.summary: Canola oil keeps 1 year from purchase in a cool dark cupboard with the cap tight. It is mostly monounsaturated, which makes it steady enough for frying, but it also carries a share of omega-3 fat, and that fraction is the first thing in the bottle to go. Canola fails by turning rancid rather than by growing anything.
en.pantry: 1 year from purchase, capped, in a dark cupboard away from any heat. Canola is refined, so the free fatty acids and most of the minor compounds that ruin an unrefined oil have already been taken out, and that is why it stands up to a hot pan. What refining cannot remove is the fat itself: roughly one part in ten of canola oil is alpha-linolenic acid, an omega-3, and omega-3 fats oxidise faster than anything else in a cooking oil. The giveaway is the smell. Where most oils go stale and waxy, an oxidised omega-3 turns distinctly fishy with a paint-like edge behind it, and because canola is bland to begin with there is no flavour of its own for that to hide behind. Sniff the neck of the bottle before you pour and you will catch it early.
en.fridge: No refrigerated figure is published for canola oil, and a bottle in weekly use has no need of a fridge. Cold does slow oxidation, so it is a reasonable home for a catering-sized bottle you are working through over months. Expect it to cloud and thicken as it chills — that is the higher-melting fats crystallising out, and it clears again on the counter. A cool cupboard away from the cooker buys most of the same protection with none of the fuss.
en.freezer: No freezer figure is published, and there is nothing to gain by freezing canola oil. It has no freezing point in the way water does; it simply becomes stiffer and cloudier, so you would be storing an inconveniently thick bottle for no extra life. Worse, a bottle carried back and forth between a freezer and a warm kitchen sweats, and the water running down the neck ends up inside. Oil offers bacteria and moulds nothing to live on — a film of water in the bottle gives them everything they need.
en.thawing: Stand a chilled bottle on the counter until the cloudiness clears and it pours freely again; half an hour is usually plenty. Do not hurry it in warm water or beside the hob. Heat is one of the four things ageing the oil, so you would be spending shelf life to save a few minutes.
spoilage: A sharp, crayon or paint-like smell — rancid oil, and decisive.
A bitter, scratchy finish at the back of the throat.
A thick, sticky film on the outside of the bottle or around the cap, which is oxidised oil polymerising.
Colour noticeably darker than when the bottle was opened.
tips: Buy a bottle you will finish within a few months, not the biggest one on the shelf.
Never store oil in the cupboard above the hob.
Wipe the neck and cap so a sticky ring does not build up.
Do not pour used frying oil back into the fresh bottle; keep it separately.

faq.q: How long does canola oil last?
faq.a: 1 year from purchase in a cool dark cupboard with the cap tight.

faq.q: Does canola oil need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: No. Refrigeration slows oxidation and suits a very large bottle used slowly, but the oil clouds and thickens in the cold. A cool cupboard away from the stove is enough.

faq.q: How can you tell if canola oil has gone off?
faq.a: Smell it. A sharp, crayon or paint-like note means it is rancid, and it will taste bitter and scratchy. That is a quality failure rather than a pathogen risk.

zh.name: 芥花油
zh.summary: 芥花油自購買日起，放陰涼避光的櫃子、瓶蓋鎖緊，可放 1 年。它以單元不飽和脂肪為主，穩定到足以下油鍋；但它同時含有一部分次亞麻油酸，而那一部分是整瓶裡最先出事的。芥花油的失敗方式是油耗，不是長東西。
zh.pantry: 自購買日起 1 年，鎖緊瓶蓋、收在遠離熱源的暗櫃裡。芥花油是精煉油，未精煉油裡最先劣化的游離脂肪酸和微量成分都已經被去掉，這就是它耐得住熱鍋的原因。精煉拿不走的是脂肪本身：芥花油裡大約十分之一是次亞麻油酸，而這類多元不飽和脂肪氧化得比油裡任何東西都快。破綻在氣味。多數油走味是變陳、帶蠟感，這一類脂肪一氧化卻會明顯發出魚腥味，後面還拖著一點油漆味；偏偏芥花油本身味道很淡，沒有自己的香氣可以掩護。倒之前先聞一下瓶口，你會提早發現。
zh.fridge: 芥花油沒有公布的冷藏期限，而一瓶每週都在用的油根本不需要冰箱。低溫確實能拖慢氧化，所以營業用大瓶、要用上好幾個月的，放冷藏是合理的。它冰過會變濁變稠，那是熔點較高的脂肪結晶出來，放回檯面就清了。遠離爐火的陰涼櫃子，大部分保護都拿得到，又完全不麻煩。
zh.freezer: 沒有公布的冷凍期限，而且冷凍芥花油沒有任何好處。它不像水有明確的凝固點，只會愈來愈稠、愈來愈濁，所以你換到的只是一瓶難倒的油，壽命並沒有變長。更糟的是，一瓶在冷凍庫和溫暖廚房之間來回的瓶子會出汗，順著瓶口流下去的水最後會跑進瓶子裡。純油本來就不提供細菌和黴菌任何養分；瓶內壁上的一層水，卻把它們需要的全給了。
zh.thawing: 把冰過的瓶子放在檯面上，等濁度散掉、能順順倒出來即可，通常半小時就夠。不要泡熱水或靠近爐台催它。熱本來就是讓這瓶油老化的四個因素之一，那等於拿保存期限去換幾分鐘。
spoilage: 聞起來刺鼻、像蠟筆或油漆味——油耗了，而且是決定性的。
入口後喉頭有苦味和刮喉感。
瓶身外側或瓶蓋周圍有一層黏稠的膜，那是氧化的油在聚合。
顏色比剛開瓶時明顯變深。
tips: 買幾個月內用得完的容量，不要挑架上最大瓶的。
絕對不要把油放在爐台上方的櫃子。
每次倒完擦一下瓶口和瓶蓋，才不會積出一圈黏膜。
用過的炸油不要倒回新油瓶，要另外裝。

faq.a: 自購買日起，陰涼避光、瓶蓋鎖緊，1 年。
不用。冷藏能拖慢氧化，適合用得很慢的大瓶裝，但低溫下會變濁變稠。放遠離爐火的陰涼櫃子就夠了。
聞一下。刺鼻、像蠟筆或油漆的味道就是油耗，吃起來會苦、會刮喉嚨。那是品質問題，不是病原菌風險。
